intent: Create a remote desert observatory where three residents track seasonal stars, maintain a cistern, and guide travelers. The world should include a dome, a shaded courtyard, and a caravan approach with clear semantic connections.

draft_v1.title: Desert Observatory
draft_v1.description: A remote observatory where residents track stars, maintain water, and guide travelers.

places.name: Star Dome
places.description: A stone dome with instruments for watching the night sky.

places.name: Shade Court
places.description: A courtyard with awnings, benches, and a shared cistern.

places.name: Caravan Approach
places.description: A marked route where travelers arrive from the salt flats.

actors.name: Tala
actors.goal: Record the next seasonal star crossing without losing the instrument notes

actors.name: Omid
actors.goal: Keep enough water available for residents and passing travelers

actors.name: Ves
actors.goal: Help caravans choose a safe approach after sunset

memories.text: The missing brass lens was wrapped in my private chart before the last sandstorm.
I count the cistern stones twice when the wind carries dust from the west.
A traveler once left a red thread at the safe marker and asked me to keep it hidden.

draft_v2.title: Desert Observatory before the Rains
draft_v2.description: A remote observatory before the seasonal rains, where residents track stars, guard water, and guide travelers from the salt flats.
